about.aboutDescription: Steam Home is an educational team project of the game store, inspired by Steam. The application provides a catalog of games, search and filtering, a shopping cart and admin tools.
about.goalDescription1: Easy viewing of games with collections, categories and detailed pages.
about.goalDescription2: Quick search by name, filters and sorting for a comfortable selection.
about.goalDescription3: Unified style, responsive screens and user-friendly experience.
about.teamDescription1: Frontend infrastructure setup, project architecture, interface integration.
about.teamDescription2: UI/UX, design system, screen design and user experience.

footer.eduDescription: This project was developed as part of training at RS School
footer.shieldCheckDescription: Information about technical data, cloud hosting, browser storage, and your rights. Read privacy policy

footer.infoDescription: This project is not affiliated with, endorsed, or sponsored by Valve Corporation or Steam.

processing.heading: Data Processing
paragraphs: Steam At Home does not require user registration and does not use analytics or advertising tracking.
The hosting provider may process technical information, including IP addresses, to ensure the operation and security of the website.
If you contact us by email, your address and message will be processed to respond to your inquiry and stored only for as long as necessary for this purpose or to comply with legal obligations.
Providing information by email is voluntary.

hosting.heading: Hosting
paragraphs: The application is hosted on Microsoft Azure in the Brazil South region, Brazil.
Microsoft may process technical information necessary to provide cloud hosting services. Data processing by the hosting provider is governed by the applicable Microsoft Data Protection Addendum.

storage.heading: Cookies and Local Storage
paragraphs: Cookies and local storage are used exclusively to remember the selected interface language and theme.
These settings can be deleted in your browser settings.

rights.heading: Your Rights
paragraphs: In accordance with applicable data protection laws, you may request access to, rectification, erasure, or portability of your personal data, restrict its processing, object to it, or withdraw consent, where applicable.
To exercise your rights, please contact alex.ovchinnikov.dev@gmail.com.
You may also lodge a complaint with the Uruguayan data protection authority, Unidad Reguladora y de Control de Datos Personales (URCDP).
